evidence: Target cold-start with 120 held-out targets and per-positive negatives (13,045 pairs, 17.14% positive)
observation: Holding out 120 targets (20% per TDL) and all their target-disease edges with per-positive negatives gives 13,045 pairs at a 17.14% positive rate. Histogram base features scored 0.500586/0.488776, GraphSAGE 0.243786/0.220993, GATv2 0.094595/0.091132 and GNN+histogram 0.118811/0.123371; F-0029 records the feature model as the cold-start leader.
subject: F-36
title: Target cold start keeps the feature model on top
